content: {"phoneNote":"The first screen is clean and shows a nice salon photo, though the city/location is missing from the initial view and the 'Kaj vam ponujamo' section duplicates the 'Cenik' right below it.","desktopNote":"The split hero and timeline opening hours work well, but the header navigation only shows 'Domov' instead of useful section anchors, and the services list is redundant above the price list.","phone":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"desktop":{"impression":4,"hierarchy":4,"imagery":4,"spacing":4,"clutter":3,"distinctiveness":4},"fixes":["Merge 'Kaj vam ponujamo' and 'Cenik' into a single section with short descriptions under each priced service so the offer isn't listed twice.","Add the city or neighborhood (Ljubljana, Celovška) to the hero eyebrow or subheadline so visitors immediately know where the salon is.","Replace the single 'Domov' link in the desktop header with anchor links to 'Delovni čas', 'Cenik', and 'Kontakt'."],"blockers":[]}
